verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair axis for a managed streaming service, since one could offer scheduled broadcasts or recurring recordings, but the evidence shows no IVS-native recurring scheduler. The EventBridge evidence describes event-triggered rules on IVS stream events, not recurring schedules. EventBridge is also an AWS host-platform service rather than an IVS capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
